Consultation Request

Tell Us About Your Goals

By submitting, you agree to our Privacy Policy. Your information is kept confidential. We respond within 24 hours.

After You Submit

What Happens Next

01

We Review

Within 24 hours, a ZARIN advisor reviews your requirements and assigns the right specialist based on your nationality and goals.

02

We Contact You

Your advisor contacts you via your preferred method â€” phone, WhatsApp, or email â€” for an initial consultation.

03

We Curate

Based on your mandate, we curate 5-8 properties that match your budget, area preference, and investment thesis.

04

You Decide

No pressure. You review the shortlist at your pace. We're here to answer questions and arrange viewings when you're ready.

Why ZARIN

Advice From an Investor, Not a Salesperson

ZARIN was founded by someone who has invested his own money in Dubai real estate since 2005. When you consult with us, you're getting advice from someone who understands what it's like to put capital at risk â€” not someone who's just trying to close a sale.
